youth.name: Enosh Burla
youth.text: Praise the Lord, this is Enosh Burla. From the very first day of my life, I believe God’s hand has been upon me. Through it all, Jesus has been my protector.

youth.name: Monica Burla
youth.text: Praise the Lord, my name is Mounica Burla. I accepted Jesus Christ as my personal Savior, took baptism, and am now joyfully serving in His ministry.

youth.name: Anusha Burla
youth.text: Praise the Lord, my name is Anusha Burla, daughter of Pastor Steven Garu. Growing up in a pastor’s family, I have been blessed to serve Him through praise and worship.

textContent.about_min_support:
Support:
Your support helps us continue our mission. Every contribution, big or small, makes a meaningful difference.
textContent.about_min_text1: Our ministry is dedicated to serving God and supporting people in their spiritual journey through worship, teaching, and fellowship.
textContent.about_min_text2: We believe in caring for others and spreading hope in our community through different programs and outreach efforts.
textContent.about_text1: We are a community-driven church focused on spreading the love and teachings of Jesus Christ under the leadership of Pastor B Steven.
textContent.about_text2: Through our diverse ministries, from Suryanarayana Colony to Subramanyam Colony, we strive to make a positive impact.
textContent.anudhina_text: In the early days of our ministry, many people showed great interest in listening to the Word of God. Pastor Garu started daily prayer sessions for two hours every day to guide and strengthen them in prayer. Slowly, many believers grew spiritually and became strong prayer warriors.
